notes:
Context: Terrabasin is a mid-market ITSM vendor building an internal helpdesk chatbot (employee-facing) to reduce L1 ticket volume. Initial ask: hosted API POC with option to move to Dedicated once steady throughput hits predictable levels. Key technical points: streaming + function/tool calling (ServiceNow create/update ticket, escalate), token-level audit logs for compliance, retention controls for 12 months (security prefers 12 mo; legal may push to 24), SSO via Okta (SAML).

AE/SE observations: very latency sensitive — CTO (Jamal Ortiz) quote: "We need first-byte / start-of-stream under 250ms for simple lookups; p95 end-to-end under 900ms when tool-calling is involved." They measured hosted API streaming start times ~300-450ms on sample workload; want improvement or guaranteed SLO.

Commercial posture: price-sensitive but willing to commit to Dedicated reserve if clear unit economics and routing/fallback policies for peak times. CFO asked for a 3-year TCO comparison (hosted vs dedicated).

Operational constraints: must retain searchable audit logs for actions taken by the agent (who called what tool, ticket IDs created) and be able to export logs to their SIEM. SE noted: need KMS integration for workspace keys and ability to set retention per environment (prod vs dev).

Stubs/links: demo recording (Fireflies above), pricing deck in Drive, pending DPA / data residency language for EU customers (future requirement).
last_meeting_summary: 01/29 POC kickoff: replayed 10k user queries; streaming helped perceived latency but p95 spikes when ServiceNow calls invoked. Priya suggested temporary caching of common KB prefixes + dedicated fallback model for short replies. Action: SE to run 24h replay with continuous batching config and return latency profile by 02/05.
